method: One warmup per mode; measured modes alternate off/on. Cold cache forced before every request using unique_cache_salt. One output token, same body with a fresh UUID actual-token prefix per request to prevent LMCache reuse. HTTP wall time includes prefill and first output; no speculative acceptance throughput normalization.
primary_metric: Actual prompt tokens / isolated request_prefill_time_seconds_sum delta; countdelta1 and zeroGPU/externalhits required. HTTP latency secondary.
